title: CFCE / GiveCredit — complete donor and initiative reporting installation

task.name: Connect original donations, provider funding and carbon retirement into usable statements
task.purpose: Let CFCE staff operate one original organization/deployment from registry and receipt intake through real payment matching, pooled provider payout attribution, carbon associations and complete donor/initiative statements. Retain the operating decisions and original source so another staff engineer can continue monthly reporting.
task.request: One selected original CFCE organization and GiveCredit Stellar deployment, its selected Stellarcarbon provider and actual donor/initiative reporting groups. Receive complete authorized registry records and native ledger/contract source, review legacy Donation-to-payment associations, save the agreed provider funding method, associate actual provider payouts with original carbon contributions, and issue the commissioned historical and current-period reports. Preserve both reporting date bases and the actual source/network edition used. The original Workshare determines operated groups, periods, review effort, commissioning fee and acceptance.
task.completeOutput: The full GiveCredit donor and initiative statements desk; complete registry, ledger and Stellarcarbon source editions; original response/XDR records; explicit payment assignments; source-dated funding capacity and saved payout allocations; versioned payout-to-carbon associations; donor, initiative and consolidated statement versions; all nine original HTML/JSON/CSV exports; and an independent editable workspace that receives, reopens, corrects an association and issues a subsequent report version.
task.repeatTrigger: The original customer reporting calendar, next actual registry/ledger/carbon source edition, new provider payout/certificate, or an agreed source association correction requires another complete period run. An unchanged reopened report retains its earlier delivery identity. The monthly operating service and its distinct invoices remain separate from underlying donations, receipt NFTs, source API calls, report files and retries.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed complete donor/initiative reporting run for the selected organization, source editions and reporting groups, or the separately commissioned installation and handover. The original Workshare supplies service prices and milestones. If a report is sold through a selected native merchant operation, record its actual atomic unit price and whole-output budget separately. Donation amounts, provider fees, pooled balances and CARBON quantities are source measures and are not the price of this reporting service.

source.reference: Maintained CFCE/GiveCredit source at stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/partners/cfce-givecredit-statements/, composed with the original Stellarcarbon desk. Select the actual original registry export/API, Stellar network, Credits contract and source-observed provider records from the customer's current deployment.
source.population: Retain the full selected original registry edition: donations, nfts, organizations, initiatives, credits, providers and stories, with impactlinks from complete nested donation relations or supplied original files. Native ledger intake closes original receipt/payment hashes, Credits donation calls, provider-account/token history and required ledger metadata through its selected source bounds. Preserve the complete original Stellarcarbon edition. Capture and report the available source coverage and acquisition interval for all three source kinds.
source.meaning: Keep Donation UUID, receipt's original payment transactionId, minted tokenId/contractId and native transfer identity distinct. Preserve original database Decimal(14,4) strings alongside exact ledger atoms, asset identity, source decimals and ledger close time. A provider pool accumulates the source-dated provider share, pays whole bucket multiples and retains an accounted remainder distinct from actual token balance. Vendor fees, provider payouts and integer residuals retain their own classifications, including shared provider/vendor addresses. A saved donor funding method and payout/carbon association freeze the original allocation revision. Registry-created and ledger-close report periods use explicit separate bases; certificate allocations known in that source edition and the separately dated retirement register retain their own dates and quantities.
source.changePolicy: Import a complete later registry, ledger or carbon edition and compare original keyed records. Carry only unchanged original payment assignments through the native carry operation. Changed source associations or funding methods are reviewed and saved as subsequent versions; existing carbon associations retain their frozen funding revision until explicitly updated. Retain previous statement versions, complete sources and original operator notes. Never apply current contract settings as historical fee/bucket values.

receiving.application: GiveCredit donor and initiative statements in Merchant Applications; maintained starforge givecredit-statements command; original browser, typed core/client, registry and Stellar ledger acquisition, and complete source. Linux with Node 22 or newer, existing Merchant private-file/flock runtime and the original Stellar SDK peer selected by the maintained distribution. The companion Stellarcarbon source is retained by that same distribution.
receiving.acceptanceRule: The receiving operator acquires/imports the selected actual registry, ledger and carbon editions; opens an original donation and its payment/receipt relations; records a justified legacy association where required; inspects original provider pool movements and source-dated capacity; saves a whole-payout allocation using the agreed method; links an actual carbon contribution; and issues the commissioned donor/initiative and consolidated statements with all nine exports. Receive the complete staff handover into another private directory, reopen independently, change an association through its next revision, produce a later report version and retain the earlier report unchanged.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The original organization/source owner authorizes registry access and identifies the actual deployment, provider, reporting groups and staff recipient. The reporting reviewer selects saved funding and source-association decisions; changed allocation revisions enter a carbon association explicitly. Each donor receives its selected statement files, while the full multi-donor staff workspace travels only to the authorized receiving operator. Control the listener through the existing Applications stop/reopen lifecycle.
receiving.recovery: Resume the same native acquisition checkpoint and original network/source bounds; preserve original successful and failed responses and source coverage. Use stable operation identities to recover saved associations, allocations and statements. Restore every original source edition, decision version, report, history and replay record through the whole-workspace importer in a new private directory, then reopen that received identity and continue reporting.
receiving.maintenance: Name the CFCE registry/access owner, original Stellar deployment and provider operator, reporting/funding reviewer, host maintainer, customer acceptance owner and receiving engineer. Keep original source/runtime versions, private access references, observed source coverage, chosen funding policy and review notes together. A recurring run captures the next edition, compares original rows, carries unchanged associations, reviews affected payout/carbon relations, issues agreed group and consolidated reports, completes the included correction round and hands over the editable workspace.

steps.title: Retain the actual original organization and commissioning terms
steps.result: Receive the complete customer Workshare seed, selected CFCE organization/deployment/provider, reporting groups, periods, scope/fee milestones and review/handover terms. Bind the actual authorized registry source, original source attachments, named reviewers and receiving host.

steps.title: Acquire complete registry and native ledger source
steps.result: Import the original registry files or run authorized complete API capture; preserve original relation closure and all available tables. Capture the selected network's original Credits calls, receipt payment hashes, provider outflows and ledger metadata, retaining source-dated settings and precision. Import the full chosen Stellarcarbon edition.

steps.title: Resolve original payment and provider-pool work
steps.result: Inspect the original Donation/receipt/payment identities, save explicit justified payment assignments, and inspect actual provider and vendor transfers. Review historical capacity and ordering from original source; select the complete payout funding method and save its exact allocated parts.

steps.title: Connect original carbon source and reporting groups
steps.result: Associate actual original provider payouts with the selected source sink transactions, freezing the chosen funding revision. Configure the actual organization, initiative/donor selections and reporting date bases. Retain many-to-many source associations and original allocation/certificate quantities.

steps.title: Prepare and correct the commissioned statement periods
steps.result: Issue all agreed historical and current donor/initiative and consolidated statements. Deliver statement.html, statement.json and the seven CSV files, including separate contributions and certificate allocations. Review changed editions and association corrections through retained subsequent versions.

steps.title: Hand over independent continuing operation
steps.result: Export all source editions, decisions, statement versions and history; receive into a distinct private directory, stop/reopen and continue an actual source association or reporting period. Complete the original staff handover and establish the contracted refresh, correction and support destinations.

inputs: Complete original CFCE customer Workshare and commissioning packet: organization/deployment/provider, reporting groups, historical/current periods, included reviews, fee milestones and handover
Authorized registry API credential reference or whole original export with source dates, ownership, original relation closure and data-use authority
Actual Stellar network/passphrase, original Credits contract, provider accounts, original receipt/payment hashes and selected ledger/archive source bounds
Original Stellarcarbon backup or complete native source edition and the actual source linking provider payouts to sinking transactions
Accountable reviewer and source for legacy Donation/payment matching, historical provider capacity and the selected donor funding method
Original organization/initiative/donor reporting selections and explicit registry-creation or payment-ledger period basis
Existing case/deployment/source IDs and actual service-payment selections when a native paid report operation is separately commissioned
Linux/Node receiving host and original SDK dependency, separate private workspace directories, named staff receiver and maintenance/refresh/correction terms
